resources.string: Nothing you dictate is kept on this phone
Once a dictation is inserted, Embersay forgets it. Try again, Last dictation, Insert again, Copy last, Undo last and the history aren\'t available. A dictation that couldn\'t be inserted is lost.
Only each dictation\'s character count, word count and language
Only each dictation\'s time, word count and length. No words, apps or how the text was inserted. To keep nothing, turn off the statistics on their page.
Embersay doesn\'t copy text to it, even when inserting fails.
Screenshots and screen recordings of Embersay are blocked, and recent apps shows a blank preview.
Turning it on deletes the recent dictations, the history and the app names in your statistics.
Anyone with your phone can see that Embersay is installed.
What you dictated into a chat, note or email stays there. Text copied earlier may remain in a keyboard\'s clipboard history, for example in Gboard or Samsung Keyboard.
Speech recognition or cleanup on a server still receives your recording or its text. To keep everything on this phone, use speech recognition on this phone and turn cleanup off.
Couldn\'t insert. Security mode keeps no copy.
Text may still appear. Security mode keeps no copy.
Screen was off. Not inserted, and security mode keeps no copy.
On this phone only, not in backups. Words and app are encrypted, the time isn\'t.
Readable only while the phone is unlocked. This needs a screen lock (PIN, pattern or password).
Before Android 12, the phone only checks this in software, which is weaker.
Copy marks the text as private, but some keyboards like Gboard and Samsung Keyboard keep their own clipboard history. Copied text may stay there.
Deleting destroys the encryption keys, so the words can\'t be read, even if the storage still holds them for a while.
Security mode keeps no history. Turn it off to keep your dictations here for a while.
Its recording is kept for a few minutes. Tap Try again and the words appear here.
Recognized. Copy it from the history.
Embersay can now keep your dictations for 24 hours, encrypted on this phone.
